summary.zh-CN: 整合此前 Beta 的皮肤编辑与测试功能，正式提供 OSK、Mania 试玩、Standard 自动测试与简洁的程序更新
summary.en-US: Bring the existing Beta editing and testing features to stable, including OSK packages, Mania playtesting, Standard auto tests and compact app updates

zh-CN: 导入 stable / lazer 导出的 OSK，在独立工作副本中修改图片、音频与配置，再导出新皮肤包，保留原始文件与 lazer JSON 布局
Mania 可自动测试或键盘试玩，检查各列普通音符、长条头身尾、六档判定、连击和舞台侧图，调整流速与 BPM
Standard 自动展示圆圈、滑条和转盘，支持 CS / AR、判定与连击素材检查，仍使用内置排列而非真实谱面
保留上隐与底部球槽的可视化设计及独立副本保存，支持画面比例、独立预览窗口与 F11 全屏
en-US: Import OSK exports from stable or lazer, edit images, audio and configuration in an independent working copy, then export a new package while preserving the original files and lazer JSON layouts
Use Mania auto tests or keyboard playtests to inspect per-column notes, hold heads, bodies and tails, six judgements, combo artwork and stage sides, with speed and BPM controls
Preview Standard circles, sliders and spinners automatically, adjust CS / AR and inspect judgement and combo assets using built-in patterns rather than real beatmaps
Keep visual upper-cover and receptor-height design with separate skin copies, aspect ratios, a detached preview window and F11 fullscreen

zh-CN: 点击检查程序更新即同时显示 Beta 与正式版结果，有新版时点击更新自动完成下载、校验与重启，连接设置保持默认折叠
正式版 1.6.0 使用构建号 10，高于 Beta r9，已有可用更新入口的 Beta 用户可通过正式版一行升级，统一构建号继续阻止降级
继续保留多线路选择与失败切换、发布签名和文件校验、旧程序备份及启动失败恢复，安装前先处理未保存修改
离线公告只包含当前正式版说明，在线公告保留 Beta r9 及此前版本历史
en-US: Check updates to see Beta and stable results together, then click Update to download, verify and restart automatically while connection settings stay collapsed by default
Stable 1.6.0 uses build number 10, above Beta r9, so Beta clients with a working updater can upgrade through the stable row while global build numbers continue to prevent downgrades
Retain multiple routes and fallback, release and file checks, executable backups and startup-failure recovery, resolving unsaved edits before installation
Bundle only the current stable release note offline and retain Beta r9 and earlier announcements online
